# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My top pick is the JBL Charge 6.** It was named best overall by What Hi-Fi?, and Best Products also ranked it first. It has an IP68 rating (dust-tight and built for immersion), 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and it can charge your phone. What Hi-Fi? lists it at $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon.
[Buy links in What Hi-Fi?'s roundup](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)

## Other picks by need

| Need | Speaker | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Loud pool party | **JBL Boombox 4** | RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, survives long immersion, and lasts 40+ hours. It's big, and the sound is narrow if you're off to the side. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) |
| Even sound all around | **Ultimate Ears Epicboom** | Tom's Guide's best overall and RTINGS' best mid-range. It has 360° sound, an IP67 rating, floats, and gets about 15 hours. It's pricier. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) |
| Budget | **Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4** | It floats, is IP67, and gets about 14 hours. Best Products lists it around $65–$80. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) |
| Cheapest and pocket-sized | **JBL Go 5** | IP67, about $40, but only 8 hours of battery. [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) |
| Easy to pack | **JBL Grip** | Can-sized, under a pound, IP68, about $100, with 12 hours of battery. Good Housekeeping's best overall. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/) |
| Big and floating, with a deal | **Soundcore Boom 2 Plus** | 100 W, IPX7, floats, up to 20 hours. It's $249.99, or $200 with code AFSC20 at Soundcore's store. It weighs 3.8 kg (about 8.4 lb), and the listing gives no dust rating, so keep it off the sand. [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus) (affiliate link; the seller earns a commission at no cost to you) |

I couldn't open the retailer pages, so prices come from the reviews and may have changed. The review links above have the current buy buttons.

## Care tips
- Look for IP67 or higher for pools and beaches. IP68 or IPX7+ plus a dust rating (the first digit) helps with sand.
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. Rinse with fresh water if the manual allows it, and let the speaker dry fully before charging. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth))
- Keep charging-port flaps closed, and keep the speaker on a towel rather than buried in sand. ([iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/))

If you tell me your budget and whether you want something pocketable or party-loud, I can narrow it to one.
